instruction: Candid outdoor full shot of a bearded man in a white t-shirt (R1) and a woman in a black hijab and white hoodie (R2) sitting on skateboards on a paved ground outside a modern building. The man (R1) sits on the left, looking forward and down, holding the top of a vertical wooden skateboard with both hands. The woman (R2) sits on the right, leaning her head on his shoulder and smiling at the camera. Natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene.
